sha256_note: Left empty on purpose: the source kit was authored offline and no hash may be invented. Run tools/prepare-openxr.ps1 -Windows -RecordHashes (or python tools/bootstrap-dependencies.py --component openxr-windows --record-hashes) once, online, to record archive_sha256 and every files[].sha256 from the first fetch; compare them against the Khronos release page, then commit this file. Until every value here is a 64 character hex digest the bootstrap refuses to run rather than skip verification.
layout_note: The release archive's internal directory names are not pinned here. The bootstrap locates include/openxr/openxr.h, the x64 openxr_loader.lib and the x64 openxr_loader.dll inside the extracted archive and installs them into install_directory under the fixed layout below, which is what engine/CMakeLists.txt expects.
